_doc: Web-level (graph-theoretic) characterization of the Qur'an concept network + the locked necessity principle, tied into the backend so engines/app read ONE source. Companion to concept_graph_features.json (per-node) — this is the WHOLE-WEB layer. Built /tmp/nest.py + /tmp/mod.py (curveball/margin-preserving nulls). 2026-06-21.

principle.exegetical_name: القرآن يفسر بعضه بعضا — the Qur'an explains itself, part by part (tafsīr al-Qur'ān bi'l-Qur'ān)
principle.exegetical_mapping: this classical principle IS the web construct: nodes interpreted by connected nodes; tafsīr-by-Qur'an = graph traversal; mutual (بعضه بعضا) ⇒ WEB with cycles, not a tree (no privileged root). Edges='illuminates'; feed-forward motifs (z+8.3)=explained directly+via intermediate; cycles (z+3.8)=reciprocal interpretation; communities (z+39)=interpretive fields; single connected component=every part reachable=self-interpreting whole. Necessity: a part's meaning is conferred by the parts that interpret it; relocation severs those edges ⇒ meaning lost.
principle.name: context constitutes meaning (holism)
principle.intra: a part's meaning is fixed by its own whole (sūra) — like an electron's state set by its atom
principle.inter: a unit's meaning/role is fixed by its bonds to other units — like inter-atomic bonding/valence
principle.topology: directed WEB (food-web), NOT a hierarchy/tree — graph theory is the native instrument
principle.necessity: a unit can't move because its meaning IS its position-in-the-whole + its bonds; relocation = a different object (cf. Ca²⁺ / Cr²⁻)
principle.analog: electron configuration (intra) + chemical bonding/valence (inter); Qur'an = molecule/lattice
